Name: Hippo's Floral Foothill Farm
Author: acearohippo
Description:
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Overview: - - -[/center][/size][/color][size=2][left]New farm, new play through... one says not having played SDV for going on two years now...
Eventually, I will, and when I do, I hope to use at least one of the farm maps I made.
Don't ask me to add anything more to this mod. I needed something simple to do and nothing more.[/left][/size][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Features: - - -[/center][/size][/color][size=2][left]Is just a farm replacement. No extra tricks or goodies, no secret areas, and none of the buildings/special areas have been moved. No fancy farm cave. No fishing outside of Riverland farm either. Guess what. This mod is MOBILE COMPATIBLE [gasps].[/left][/size][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Requirements: - - -[/center][/size][/color][size=2][left][list]
[*]Content Patcher
[*]DaisyNiko's Tilesheets
[*]Farm Type Manager
[/list][/left][/size][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Install/Uninstall: - - -[/center][/size][/color][size=2][left] Extract zipped file and place content in your Mods folder. Make sure you downloaded the correct version! (PC for SDV 1.5+ and Mobile for 1.4.5).[/left][/size][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Mods I Recommend: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
[left][size=2]Any recolour and/or reshade mods you might find on your own. Foliage and building retextures are also always a great addition. See preview pictures for different recolours.[/size][/left][color=#6aa84f][size=3][center]- - - Mods in Pics: - - -[/center][/size][/color]
